changelog: Movie and series pages can show the collections a title belongs to: first the film's TMDB collection, every film in it including the ones you don't have yet, so they can be requested, then each server collection holding the title. Needs an Orca X build with collection shelves. Includes 1.4.13.6: finding streams no longer hangs on one unreachable indexer. Requires Jellyfin 12.1 or later. This is a beta release.
description: Server-side intelligence engine for the Orca X TV app: personalization, recommendations, caching, and centralized administration.
name: Orca Engine
overview: The brain/backbone for the Orca X Android TV client.
